summaries.en: Korail announced that Gyeongbu Line train services, which were suspended between Cheonan and Daejeon due to a freight train derailment, will resume from the first train tomorrow.
summaries.zh: 韩国铁道公社Korail宣布，因京釜线货运列车脱轨事故而暂停的天安-大田区间列车服务将从明天首班车起恢复运行。
